sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Sew it Good - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I need your help again, brother. You really came through for me with that backpack and mask. This time, I need some specific rigs. I want to test a few things before releasing my own versions... Ahem, alright, I won't bore you with the details. I'll tell you later, don't want to jinx it!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 2 WARTECH TV-109 + TV-106 chest rigs in raid
- Hand over the chest rigs
- Find 2 BlackRock chest rigs in raid
- Hand over the chest rigs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× 6B5-15 Zh-86 Uley armored rig (Flora)
- Unlocks craft for 6B23-2 body armor (Mountain Flora) at Lavatory level 1
"Much appreciated, brother! Leave them here. And here's your reward."
